integrity.first_publication_date_basis: 2015-02-16 original arXiv submission of focal finite-cluster Ising methodology; dated McGee construction source 2015-09-15.
integrity.historical_priority_limit: Unindexed cut enumerators or historical tables could contain the same result.
integrity.proof_basis: Complete exact integer enumeration of all 2^24 spin assignments by two independently implemented algorithms; finite exhaustive evidence is not a universal graph-family theorem.

scientific_limitations: Finite labelled 24-vertex classical Ising cluster with uniform positive nearest-neighbor J and real longitudinal h; zero-temperature ground states and the first zero-field excitation only. No finite-temperature closed partition function or thermodynamic transition is asserted.
title: Exact magnetic response and first excitation of the McGee Ising antiferromagnet
